name: The Global Fund
body: DMARC rejects spoofed mail, every image analyzed has alt text, every page a meta description, and Core Web Vitals pass for real visitors. But the start page sends no Cache-Control, so browsers and CDNs guess.
lesson: Send Cache-Control on HTML, such as a short max-age, and a long max-age on fingerprinted assets.
summary: www.theglobalfund.org scores 81 out of 100 (B). 3 checks fail now, 12 are at risk, and 23 pass. Fix first: 1 AI answer or search crawler is blocked.

fix.title: 1 AI answer or search crawler is blocked
fix.evidence: Amazonbot (Alexa answers) by Disallow: /. These bots fetch pages to cite them in answers. Blocked means the site is not quoted there.
fix.fix: Allow the answer bots in robots.txt. Training bots can stay blocked if that is the policy.

fix.title: 1 form control has no label
fix.evidence: On /en/private-sector-and-philanthropy/. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 18 titles run past about 60 characters
fix.evidence: /fr/ (82), /en/about-the-global-fund/ (79), /en/staff/ (78), /en/strategy/ (66) and 14 more. Google cuts them with an ellipsis.
fix.fix: Lead with the words that matter and keep titles near 60 characters.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Matomo appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: The start page took 2044 ms to arrive
fix.evidence: That is the HTML alone, before images and scripts.
fix.fix: Cache the HTML at the edge, or speed up the server render.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles. The page links 4 profiles that could go in sameAs.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
Model-training crawlers are blocked by choice
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
Core Web Vitals pass for real visitors
Every page has a meta description
